source_type: Mixed: credible journalism (BBC, The Guardian) and regulatory body announcement (Financial Reporting Council)
source_quality: A-level: FRC regulatory sanction notice, administrator reports, company regulatory announcements. B-level: BBC and Guardian journalism covering the administration and its causes.
contamination_notes: The BBC and Guardian articles describe the administration outcome and some root-cause conclusions that postdate the input decision date of 2018-10-09. The FRC sanction (2021) is entirely post-outcome. These materials are used only to ground the outcome.json and are explicitly excluded from input.json and 01_case_input.json. Input files are constructed only from facts knowable at the decision date.
source_limitations: Administration outcome, store sale/closures, confirmed fraud conclusions, FRC sanctions, and later criminal or civil proceedings all postdate the decision date and must not appear in input or case-input files. Sources establish the ground truth for outcome scoring only.
